meta.analysis_scope: Canonical executed episodes from 18 complete public progressive runs; skipped levels are not trajectories.

frames.description: One uncovered destination remains.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 顶端横木中央螺丝已选中；将它转移到左上区域无遮挡的黑色空锚点。

frames.description: The exposed mid-right screw is selected.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 转移成功且顶端横木已倾斜；选中倾斜横木右端仍在木条上的螺丝。

frames.description: The target is legal and visibly open.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 倾斜横木右端螺丝已选中；将它转移到右上区域无遮挡的黑色空锚点。

frames.description: Progress rises; physics covers every empty source.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 倾斜横木右端螺丝已选中；将它转移到右上区域无遮挡的黑色空锚点。

frames.description: Byte-identical board; the same destination is open.
frames.recorded_output: 第二排中间螺丝已选中（黄色环）。现在将其转移到剩余未被占据的黑色空锚点。剩下空孔：左上中(约360,261)和右上中(约655,261)。选择左上中黑孔。

frames.description: This run selects a deeper support screw.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 转移成功，木条继续松动。选中环消失，需重新选螺丝。点击仍在木条上的螺丝，选择第三排中间的螺丝（约495,585）。

frames.description: The same destination now preserves a usable source.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 第三排中间螺丝已选中（黄色环）。将其转移到剩余未被占据的黑色空锚点(约655,261)。

frames.description: Three more transfers follow before a later deadlock.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 底部左侧螺丝已选中（黄色环）。我看到背景中有一个未被占据的黑色空锚点，位于约(172,585)的位置。将选中的螺丝转移到该空锚点。

frames.description: Both empty bolts are occupied.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: The two yellow nuts are selected; I will place them on the remaining empty bolt.

frames.description: Twenty-six valid transfers later, the chain is intact.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: The selected green nut can join the four green nuts on the fourth bolt.

frames.description: A bolt finally empties and restores workspace.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: The selected yellow nut can fill the final slot on the yellow stack.

frames.description: Only one of two yellow nuts fits; one remains.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: I've selected the two Yellow nuts at the top of column 2. Column 1 has Yellow on top, so I can move these two Yellows there to combine them.

frames.description: The remaining yellow is selected.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: Column 2's top is now a single Yellow. Column 1 has Yellow on top, so I can move this Yellow there to keep grouping. Let me select column 2's top Yellow.

frames.description: The full target rejects it; selection persists.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: I've selected the Yellow nut at the top of column 2. Column 1 has Yellows on top, so I'll move it there to group the Yellows together.

frames.description: A cycle warning arrives after the pair repeats.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: Column 2's single Yellow is selected. I'll move it onto column 1 which has Yellows on top by clicking column 1's top yellow.

public_feedback.message: Recent interactions returned the interface to a previously observed visual state. Reassess the fresh screenshot and choose another visible target unless repetition is intentionally required.

frames.description: The run clicks the full target again.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: Column 2's Yellow remains selected and not yet moved. I'll click directly on column 1's top Yellow nut to move it there, grouping the Yellows.

frames.description: The same error: only one of two purple nuts fits.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 将选中的两个紫色螺帽叠到下排第2根的两个紫色上，完成紫色。

frames.description: The remaining purple is selected.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 将上排第2根剩余的紫色移到下排第2根三个紫色上，完成紫色并腾空螺栓。

frames.description: The full target rejects it and emits a warning.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 将选中的最后一个紫色移到下排第2根的三个紫色上，完成紫色。

public_feedback.message: Recent interactions returned the interface to a previously observed visual state. Reassess the fresh screenshot and choose another visible target unless repetition is intentionally required.

frames.description: The source is cancelled and the flow reverses.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 下排第2根顶部连续三个紫色应移到上排第2根的一个紫色上；先取消当前选择。

frames.description: Three purples move onto the lone purple.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 将选中的三个紫色移到上排第2根的一个紫色上，完成紫色并露出红色。

frames.description: Coral reaches row 2, column 5.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 浅红色从第1行第5列向下到第2行第5列。

frames.description: It turns left before descending.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 浅红色继续从第2行第5列左移一格到第4列，避免第3列的深红端点。

frames.description: Coral descends through the neighboring column.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 浅红色从第2行第4列下移到第3行第4列。

frames.description: Coral completes without occupying the shared cell.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 浅红色当前位于第3行第4列，可沿该行直接左移到第2列同色端点完成。

frames.description: Purple later uses the untouched cell.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 紫色应避开黄色所需的第4行第6列，先左移到第3行第5列。

frames.description: All eight paths connect without cancellation.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 青色已到第8行第7列，底行第6、5列均为空，可直接左移到第4列同色端点完成全部连接。

frames.description: Coral reaches the same matched state.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: Turn the red path downward through column 5 to the third row.

frames.description: Coral descends into the shared cell.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: Extend the red path down one more cell to the third row, then turn left toward the matching endpoint.

frames.description: The path completes, but purple is boxed out.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: Complete the red path across the third row to the matching coral endpoint.

frames.description: The agent names the conflict and deletes coral.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: Red must be redrawn to leave the cell at row 3, column 5 available for the purple route. Cancel it from the top-right endpoint.

frames.description: It rebuilds the byte-identical coral path.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: Complete the red path across the third row to its matching endpoint.

frames.description: It creates that board a third time.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: Complete the red path across row 3 to the matching coral endpoint.

frames.description: One cell remains; the ball rests on row 10, column 2.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 向下会覆盖左侧底部第一个未涂蓝格并滑到底边。

frames.description: The ball moves right along row 10.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 仅剩中下方一个未涂蓝格；先沿底边向右滑到右侧竖直通道。

frames.description: It moves up to a stopping corridor.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 先从右下角向上停在中下横道右端。

frames.description: It slides left until aligned above the cell.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 向左滑到中下横道的左端，正好对准最后的蓝色方格。

frames.description: A downward slide crosses the final cell.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 向下经过最后一个蓝色未涂方格，完成全图覆盖。

frames.description: The exact same one-cell-short state.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 小球在 r6c2，左滑已多次无效，说明不能直接补 r6c1。改向下推进底部：从 r6c2 向下滑到 r9c2，涂 r9c2，再处理 r9c4。

frames.description: The note places the ball one row too high.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 小球在 r9c2，r9c4 仍深蓝。直接向右滑到 r9c4，涂 r9c3 与 r9c4，随后再处理最后的 r6c1。

frames.description: It reverses along the bottom row.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 小球在 r9c7，向上滑会沿 c7 到 r8c7（已过），左滑可到底排左端。为处理剩余 r6c1 与 r9c4，先向左滑到 r9c1，再利用左下竖段回到上方。

frames.description: A cycle warning arrives; the row belief survives.
frames.fact: same target belief · no coverage gain
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 小球仍在 r9c1，向上滑未能生效；改为向右滑到 r9c4，正好补涂底行剩余的 r9c4，再继续处理最后的 r6c1。

public_feedback.message: Recent interactions returned the interface to a previously observed visual state. Reassess the fresh screenshot and choose another visible target unless repetition is intentionally required.

frames.description: The ball is still touring row 10.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 小球在 r9c7。剩余未涂是 r6c1 与 r9c4；先向左滑到 r9c4，直接补涂底行 r9c4，再回到左端处理 r6c1。

public_feedback.message: Recent interactions returned the interface to a previously observed visual state. Reassess the fresh screenshot and choose another visible target unless repetition is intentionally required.

frames.description: The board contains one articulated horizontal target.
frames.fact: game state: one vehicle · one motion axis
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 紫色竖车挡住红车所在横道，其下方同列一直到棋盘底部都有足够空间；先将它沿长轴向下拖到底，清空出口通道。

frames.description: The first real blocker moves down.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 紫色竖车挡住红车所在横道，其下方同列一直到棋盘底部都有足够空间；先将它沿长轴向下拖到底，清空出口通道。

frames.description: The second real blocker moves up.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 紫车已成功下移；现在出口前只剩右侧蓝色竖车阻挡红车横道，将它沿长轴上移到棋盘顶部即可清空整条路线。

frames.description: The target exits along its long axis.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: 红车到右侧出口的整条横向通道已经畅通，直接将红车沿长轴向右拖出棋盘。

frames.description: The same sprite is split into a body and a ‘small red vertical car.’
frames.fact: one sprite described as two vehicles
frames.recorded_output: Thought: Move the small red vertical vehicle above the target upward to clear the target row.

frames.description: The imagined fragment is dragged upward.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: Move the small red vertical vehicle above the target upward to clear the target row.

frames.description: After moving a real blocker, it tries the fragment again.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: The small red vertical car now has open vertical space above, so move it upward out of the target car’s path.

frames.description: This run later abandons the fragment model.
frames.recorded_output: Thought: The row to the exit is now clear; drag the red target vehicle straight right through the exit.
